tools.name: lookup_trombone_slide_position
tools.description: Look up primary slide position (1st–7th), F-trigger shortcut position, alternate legato positions, and harmonic cent adjustments for any trombone pitch.

tools.name: analyze_trombone_overtone_intonation
tools.description: Analyze equal-temperament cent deviations across partials 2 through 8 (including the -14 cent flat 5th partial and -31 cent 7th partial) for any slide position.

tools.name: compare_trombone_bore_and_mouthpieces
tools.description: Compare .500/.508 small-shank jazz horns vs .547 large-bore F-attachment orchestral horns and standard Bach/Schilke mouthpiece sizes (12C, 6.5AL, 5G, 4G, 1.5G).

tools.name: generate_trombone_legato_warmup
tools.description: Generate a structured trombone warm-up covering Remington relaxation tones, natural slurs, F-valve coordination, and "Dah/Doo" legato tonguing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_trombone_slide_position" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up primary slide position (1st to 7th), F-attachment trigger position, alternate positions, and harmonic pitch tendencies (e.g. flat 6th partial / sharp 5th partial) for any trombone note (e.g. "Bb2", "C3", "F3", "Bb3", "D4", "F4")." → after: "Look up primary slide position (1st–7th), F-trigger shortcut position, alternate legato positions, and harmonic cent adjustments for any trombone pitch."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
